assessment: This important work by Meseguer et al. depicts findings that substantially advance our understanding of clade diversification across major Neotropical bioregions. The evidence that summarises the evolutionary diversity dynamics of 150 time-calibrated clades of neotropical plants and animals data is convincingly presented with current state-of-the-art analyses. The work will be of interest to evolutionary biologists and biogeographers working to understand the origins of the most biodiverse land mass on the planet.
